candidate.answerReason: Since \(\pi\) radians equals \(180^\circ\), \(2\pi\) radians equals \(2\cdot180^\circ=360^\circ\), one full revolution.

methods.label: Recognize one full revolution
methods.explanation: Half of two full revolutions is one full revolution, and \(2\pi\) radians equals \(360^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the degree-radian equivalence and the elementary meaning of a full revolution.
